meta.promptText: Which vitamin C serum should I buy for dark spots and dull skin in India?

response.text:
For dark spots and dull skin in India, start with **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum**. It is a sensible beginner strength and is specifically marketed for dark spots, uneven tone, dullness, and UV-related damage; it also has substantial customer feedback on Indian marketplaces.[1][2]

## Good alternatives

- **The Derma Co 10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide** — a good option if you also want niacinamide for uneven tone and pigmentation.[7]
- **Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C Serum** — consider this if your skin is oily or easily irritated; it is marketed as a non-irritating, dermatologist-co-created formula.[5]
- **Pilgrim 10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide** — suitable if you prefer a beginner-friendly, all-skin-types formula, though marketplace ratings are somewhat lower than Minimalist’s.[1][6]
- **Foxtale 15% Vitamin C** — better reserved for experienced users whose skin already tolerates vitamin C; higher strength can be more irritating.[3]

## How to use it

Apply 2–3 drops to clean, dry skin **2–3 mornings per week**, then moisturiser and broad-spectrum **SPF 30–50 sunscreen every day**. After two weeks without stinging, redness, or breakouts, increase to once daily. Sunscreen is essential; otherwise UV exposure can maintain dark spots and reduce the benefit of treatment.

Patch-test first, avoid applying it on irritated skin, and do not combine it initially with exfoliating acids or retinoids in the same routine. Expect gradual improvement over roughly **8–12 weeks**, not an immediate change.
